properties.name: Decision Point
properties.description:
Concern
Steep and convex with terrain traps.
Windloading.
Slopes threatening from above.
Managing risk
Analyze your route thoroughly from a safe zone. Look for options to eliminate or reduce your exposure.
Watch for clues of unstable snow such as shooting cracks, whumpfing and/or natural avalanches.

properties.name: Decision Point
properties.description:
Concern
Terrain characteristics (steep, convex).
Windloading.
Managing risk
Watch for clues of unstable snow such as shooting cracks, whumpfing and/or natural avalanches.
Minimize exposure by spreading out and walking up the shortest and least steep part of the slope .

properties.name: Decision Point
properties.description:
Concern
Windloading and cornices.
Steep and gullied.
Managing risk
Watch for clues of unstable snow such as shooting cracks, whumpfing and/or natural avalanches.
The ridgeline offers a very narrow band of safety. Approach slope break-overs with caution.
Start on small, manageable slopes and work up to larger slopes only when you have gained absolute confidence in the snowpack.
